description: This file defines the CalendarGrid class used for rendering various views of a calendar (month, week, day, etc.) in the SuiteCRM application. It includes methods for generating HTML output for calendar grids, time columns, day slots, and mobile-specific views.

classes.name: CalendarGrid
classes.description: Main class responsible for generating HTML calendar views for different periods and styles, including mobile and shared views.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the CalendarGrid object, setting up properties like weekdays, time format, and scroll behavior based on the Calendar object.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Dispatches to specific view rendering methods (month, week, day, etc.) based on the Calendar's view.

methods.name: get_time_column
methods.description: Generates HTML for the time labels column in grid views.

methods.name: get_day_column
methods.description: Generates HTML for individual day columns in grid views.

methods.name: display_mobile
methods.description: Returns HTML for mobile view of calendar items, grouped by day with styling.

methods.name: mobile_display_items
methods.description: Creates HTML representation of a single calendar item for mobile view.

methods.name: mobile_get_end_time
methods.description: Calculates the end time of a mobile calendar item based on start time and duration.

methods.name: mobile_get_type_colour
methods.description: Returns color associated with the type of calendar item (meeting, call, task).

methods.name: mobile_get_status_colour
methods.description: Returns color associated with the status of a calendar item.

methods.name: mobile_sort_items
methods.description: Sorts calendar items for a day based on start time.

methods.name: get_basic_cell
methods.description: Generates HTML for a basic (non-scrollable) calendar cell.

methods.name: get_basic_row
methods.description: Generates HTML for a row of calendar cells, either week or month view.

methods.name: get_day_head
methods.description: Generates HTML for the header of a day column.

methods.name: display_week
methods.description: Builds HTML for a week view of the calendar.

methods.name: display_day
methods.description: Builds HTML for a day view of the calendar.

methods.name: display_month
methods.description: Builds HTML for a month view of the calendar.

methods.name: display_shared
methods.description: Builds HTML for shared calendar views involving multiple users.

methods.name: display_year
methods.description: Builds HTML for a yearly calendar overview.
